# has repository

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasRepository`](gmeow-hasRepository.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasRepository>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)

Relates a project to a version-control repository that hosts its codebase. Non-functional: a project may have several repositories (monorepo, mirrors, forks).

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Project`](../classes/gmeow-Project.md) -> [`gmeow:Repository`](../classes/gmeow-Repository.md)
